purpose: independent re-verification of the two vertices that NAIL_WEIGHT_AUDIT treats as thumb nail vertices but which are NOT dominated by THUMB_IP_R
nail_definition_used_by_R1_audit: vertex belongs to a polygon with material_index==1 whose FACE centroid is owned by THUMB (nearest chain)

1383.classification: SHARED_SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY_VERTEX (nail/skin border of the thumb nail: incident to both NAIL_BED and non-NAIL faces)
1383.region_classification_source: NAIL_WEIGHT_AUDIT / R1 build: material_index==1 face whose FACE centroid ownership == THUMB -> vertex pulled into NAIL_BY_DIGIT['THUMB']; the VERTEX level owner (nearest chain by 2-D polyline distance) is however INDEX, which is what drove the R1 weight allocation
1383.why_r1_gave_it_no_thumb_bone: OWN_V(v)=INDEX and d_poly(v,THUMB)=8.29 mm: outside the R1 first-web band (threshold 7.78 mm), so the web cross-blend never ran and THUMB_* was not in the allowed set
